rows.subject: plan_id
rows.source: the original AssistantPlan document-version commit and its exact schedule binding; original Project APR-017/SP-306 custody or APR-073/CV-366 application edition
rows.rule: A genuinely committed new Plan version invalidates that Plan’s pending exact-version binding. Preserve the old binding as audit; never silently rebind to the new version. This records the Plan-side fact, not the Scheduling owner’s distinct execution_window.invalidated. No timer, schedule opening, unchanged revision or Build completion emits it.
rows.positive: Commit V3 after scheduling V2; retain the V2 binding, record V3 and the reason, with no build.

rows.subject: scenario_id
rows.source: CRAU-096 original project-state scenario, resolved compose configuration, validation result and cmd.docker.compose.scenario.delete original result receipt
rows.rule: A validated cmd.docker.compose.scenario.delete removes the scenario from the exact Project’s current scenario list, retaining the original ID and source refs in history. Existing validation must succeed; deletion is not compose down and never claims containers stopped.
rows.positive: Use one valid Project scenario with resolved config, validated service/profile/env references and the original deleted result; no other scenario changes.

rows.subject: scenario_id
rows.source: CRAU-096 original project-state scenario, resolved compose configuration, validation result and cmd.docker.compose.scenario.edit original result receipt
rows.rule: A validated cmd.docker.compose.scenario.edit commits an actual change of one existing scenario against its original currentness. An unchanged edit emits nothing. Stale fingerprints must pass the existing validation/repair path before edit is enabled.
rows.positive: Use one valid Project scenario with resolved config, validated service/profile/env references and the original edited result; no other scenario changes.

rows.subject: scenario_id
rows.source: CRAU-096 original project-state scenario, resolved compose configuration, validation result and cmd.docker.compose.scenario.run original result receipt
rows.rule: cmd.docker.compose.scenario.run records the original owner-confirmed launch/run activity receipt for the exact validated scenario and compose config-hash. Dispatch acceptance alone is insufficient; the run receipt proves the launch, never health, test pass or terminal success. Restart reads this receipt and never reruns Compose.
rows.positive: Use one valid Project scenario with resolved config, validated service/profile/env references and the original run result; no other scenario changes.

rows.positive: Use one valid Project scenario with resolved config, validated service/profile/env references and the original saved result; no other scenario changes.

rows.subject: schedule_id
rows.source: SQR-003/004/007 ExecutionSchedule original operation and source record; original SP-306 v1/v2 Project custody or SQR-019/SP-352 exact application source
rows.rule: A cmd.execution_window.create or the atomic cmd.chat.plan.schedule_build transaction creates one exact ExecutionSchedule. Build At never emits a second create command. Window creation alone starts no work.
rows.positive: Read one genuine created schedule result with the exact target and original source edition, preserving grace and occurrence identity.

rows.subject: schedule_id
rows.source: SQR-003/004/007 ExecutionSchedule original operation and source record; original SP-306 v1/v2 Project custody or SQR-019/SP-352 exact application source
rows.rule: The Scheduling owner records its existing target-deleted, target-cancelled, target-already-invalidated or exact-version-change invalidation result, preserving the exact original nonempty invalidated_reason without a local reason-code translation. The invalidated record retains its exact former target and reason; it never binds latest or retries a dead target. This is the window-side fact distinct from Assistant Plan’s version-change fact.
rows.positive: Read one genuine invalidated schedule result with the exact target and original source edition, preserving grace and occurrence identity.

rows.subject: schedule_id
rows.source: SQR-003/004/007 ExecutionSchedule original operation and source record; original SP-306 v1/v2 Project custody or SQR-019/SP-352 exact application source
rows.rule: An accepted cmd.execution_window.update changes the original schedule against its expected revision. Narrowing an in-flight window takes effect at the next safe wind-down boundary; it never interrupts an atomic write or silently changes admission.
rows.positive: Read one genuine updated schedule result with the exact target and original source edition, preserving grace and occurrence identity.

rows.subject: continuation_id
rows.source: GoalContinuationRecord pm.goal.continuation.v2, canonical Goal revision and original host continuation decision (GRS-086 selects the exact application source edition)
rows.rule: One host evaluation at a continuation boundary records continue/complete/pause/blocked/cancelled, the exact Goal revision, owning run, next attempt and observed user_stop_epoch. Continue requires unfinished objective, eligible thread, runnable attempt and unchanged Stop epoch again at dispatch; complete requires genuine caller-owned completion evidence. This event neither schedules a second turn nor mutates Goal body. Use the existing idempotency tuple (goal_id, goal_revision, owning_run_id, next_attempt_ref), with canonical explicit null for no next attempt; a reevaluation is a distinct original decision only when a genuine owner-state change changes that existing tuple; the same tuple always resolves its one original under GRS-050, never a reminted effect ID.
rows.positive: A host evaluates an unfinished Goal with a genuine next attempt and unchanged epoch; also plan an independently valid complete case backed by caller evidence.

rows.subject: named_plan_id
rows.source: NPLAN-001/002 NamedPlanRecord and original action receipt; NPLAN-006 genuine child-owner/aggregate snapshot for changed child refs
rows.rule: cmd.named_plan.archive commits active to archived. Active child work requires the existing explicit warning/confirmation and preserve_unchanged disposition; no child is cancelled or deleted.
rows.positive: One exact Project+NamedPlan original archived result with unchanged child runtime; duplicate display names in the Project are independently valid.

rows.subject: named_plan_id
rows.source: NPLAN-001/002 NamedPlanRecord and original action receipt; NPLAN-006 genuine child-owner/aggregate snapshot for changed child refs
rows.rule: NamedPlanOwner::commit_child_refs commits an actual current/historical edge change from a genuine child-owner publication at a consistent snapshot. NPLAN-006 validates child kind/ref/revision/hash and Project+NamedPlan parent edges; preserve historical refs and zero-or-one current primary PRD. No bare focus, opaque ref, history read or lifecycle claim proves a join.
rows.positive: One exact Project+NamedPlan original child_refs_changed result with unchanged child runtime; duplicate display names in the Project are independently valid.

rows.positive: One exact Project+NamedPlan original created result with unchanged child runtime; duplicate display names in the Project are independently valid.

rows.subject: named_plan_id

rows.subject: pause_record_ref
rows.source: SQR-018/SP-323 Project pause original command result or SQR-020/CV-368/SP-352 application/Server original whole-value CAS receipt
rows.rule: Only an authorized user’s real absolute-value change of the named Project or app/Server pause emits once. Same-value set returns the unchanged original result, no event/revision/epoch change. The original source supplies paused, user_stop_epoch, actor and changed time: true advances the selected scope epoch, false clears only that scope and preserves per-run Stop. No Settings default, missing-as-off, automatic clear, no-op event or backlog dispatch. Project request still has no expected_revision; application uses its existing internal whole-value CAS and unavailable/null-pause branch.
rows.positive: User changes the selected Project latch off to on; separately use genuine application Server source with null Project and no fake thread/Computer request fields.
rows.owner_investigation: Frozen census Commands citation is a lead. Current SQR-018/020 explicitly own the operational pause; CS-1565 points to SQR-1565 without competing ownership.

rows.subject: run_id
rows.source: SQR-005/006 original quota wait, QuotaResumeConsent or eligibility decision receipt, actual provider/account and actual run owner; SP-306 Project or SQR-019/SP-352 application source
rows.rule: The server Scheduling owner records each genuine quota-resume eligibility decision, including refusal and its exact failed clauses; this is an attempt, never an assertion that work ran. Revalidate SQR-006 at decision and final dispatch; a pre-Stop decision delivered afterwards refuses. Accepted eligibility resumes only the same unfinished binding and never redoes committed work.
rows.positive: Use a genuine quota_resume_attempted original source with exact route; separately cover unknown reset truth with no fabricated reset time.

rows.subject: run_id
rows.source: SQR-005/006 original quota wait, QuotaResumeConsent or eligibility decision receipt, actual provider/account and actual run owner; SP-306 Project or SQR-019/SP-352 application source
rows.rule: cmd.runtime.quota_resume.set commits the actual opt-in consent change scoped to run/provider/account; enabled defaults false only at genuine creation, never by a new global Settings write. Record exact reset truth and source; unchanged consent is no change. Stop/pause remains higher priority and consent never clears it.
rows.positive: Use a genuine quota_resume_consent_changed original source with exact route; separately cover unknown reset truth with no fabricated reset time.

rows.subject: run_id
rows.source: SQR-005/006 original quota wait, QuotaResumeConsent or eligibility decision receipt, actual provider/account and actual run owner; SP-306 Project or SQR-019/SP-352 application source
rows.rule: Provider usage exhaustion places an existing unfinished run into the shared quota wait. Record the genuine run wait entry and reset truth; unknown stays unknown and a local estimate never becomes provider fact. Goal remains active and Plan remains Building; there is no Goal/To-Do blocked transition merely because of quota.
rows.positive: Use a genuine quota_wait_started original source with exact route; separately cover unknown reset truth with no fabricated reset time.

rows.rule: cmd.chat.schedule_message.cancel makes a pending scheduled/held dispatch cancelled; retain the snapshot for audit and never dispatch it. Cancellation is terminal for that pending snapshot; it is not a Stop command for already admitted work.
rows.positive: Use one exact frozen message snapshot and genuine cancelled result; no client timer or focused-chat substitution.

rows.rule: cmd.chat.schedule_message freezes exactly the Schedule Message sheet’s text, attachments, destination and chosen runtime/model/account route in one durable snapshot. Empty sheet text fails regardless of composer text. Commit acknowledges the snapshot and starts no run, Goal, Plan or To-Do.

rows.positive: Use one exact frozen message snapshot and genuine failed result; no client timer or focused-chat substitution.

rows.positive: Use one exact frozen message snapshot and genuine held result; no client timer or focused-chat substitution.

rows.subject: todo_id
rows.source: TDR-001..009/012 original TodoItemV2, candidate graph, TodoWorkBinding and individually receipted TodoTransition or replacement disposition; explicit null Project application thread keeps identical thread-local authority
rows.rule: ToDoController validates a proposal and atomically creates one new pending TodoItemV2 in the sole thread-local list. Stable item identity and graph edges are checked first; no cross-thread aggregation or whole-list model authority.
rows.positive: A validated created result in one current thread, preserving exact item identity and all unaffected edges/work; a separate valid application thread uses null Project.

rows.subject: todo_id
rows.source: TDR-001..009/012 original TodoItemV2, candidate graph, TodoWorkBinding and individually receipted TodoTransition or replacement disposition; explicit null Project application thread keeps identical thread-local authority
rows.rule: ToDoController validates the full candidate graph and atomically changes current depends_on edges of one item. Reject self/unknown/cross-thread refs and cycles before any commit. Dependency is independent of display order; a resulting status change is individually receipted separately.
rows.positive: A validated dependency_changed result in one current thread, preserving exact item identity and all unaffected edges/work; a separate valid application thread uses null Project.

rows.subject: todo_id
rows.source: TDR-001..009/012 original TodoItemV2, candidate graph, TodoWorkBinding and individually receipted TodoTransition or replacement disposition; explicit null Project application thread keeps identical thread-local authority
rows.rule: ToDoController records removal from current graph membership without completion, skip or deletion of history. A replacement transaction classifies all active work as retained/rebound/cancelled-at-safe-boundary/refused before commit; no work is orphaned. Historical removed edges cannot later mutate parent rollup.
rows.positive: A validated removed_from_current_list result in one current thread, preserving exact item identity and all unaffected edges/work; a separate valid application thread uses null Project.

rows.subject: todo_id
rows.source: TDR-001..009/012 original TodoItemV2, candidate graph, TodoWorkBinding and individually receipted TodoTransition or replacement disposition; explicit null Project application thread keeps identical thread-local authority
rows.rule: ToDoController changes only display_order in the current parent/thread scope. Preserve dependencies, parent links, parallel groups, active work and status. Display order neither authorizes execution nor imposes a single in-progress item.
rows.positive: A validated reordered result in one current thread, preserving exact item identity and all unaffected edges/work; a separate valid application thread uses null Project.

rows.subject: todo_id
rows.source: TDR-001..009/012 original TodoItemV2, candidate graph, TodoWorkBinding and individually receipted TodoTransition or replacement disposition; explicit null Project application thread keeps identical thread-local authority
rows.rule: ToDoController commits exactly one individually receipted TodoTransition per actual status change. Cause is one of the eight existing values. Completion requires item-level accepted outcome evidence (including conversational outcome, not necessarily a tool receipt); tool success alone is insufficient. Parent rollup uses current required children; dependency wait is pending, and quota wait leaves admitted in_progress work in_progress. Bulk completion without each item’s proof fails atomically.
rows.positive: A validated status_changed result in one current thread, preserving exact item identity and all unaffected edges/work; a separate valid application thread uses null Project.

rows.subject: todo_id
rows.source: TDR-001..009/012 original TodoItemV2, candidate graph, TodoWorkBinding and individually receipted TodoTransition or replacement disposition; explicit null Project application thread keeps identical thread-local authority
rows.rule: ToDoController validates an actual current item content update against the expected revision; the historical title operation maps here. Unsupported summary/owner_hint/verification_hint/notes do not become new fields, work bindings or status authority. Status/dependency/order changes use their own actual per-item facts.
rows.positive: A validated updated result in one current thread, preserving exact item identity and all unaffected edges/work; a separate valid application thread uses null Project.

rows.subject: todo_id
rows.source: TDR-001..009/012 original TodoItemV2, candidate graph, TodoWorkBinding and individually receipted TodoTransition or replacement disposition; explicit null Project application thread keeps identical thread-local authority
rows.rule: ToDoController attaches the genuine TodoWorkBinding of one admitted leaf with exact work_id/attempt_id, expected outcome and owner admission receipt. Never infer binding from a title, hint, source note or provider status. Any resulting real status transition has its own TodoTransition and todo.status_changed.
rows.positive: A validated work_bound result in one current thread, preserving exact item identity and all unaffected edges/work; a separate valid application thread uses null Project.
